shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I like to cook new recipes on weekends.
Traveling to new places is always an adventure.
I often listen to music while studying or working.
My friends and I like to play board games together.
I believe that volunteering is a rewarding experience.
Spending time outdoors helps me to relax and recharge.
I find it beneficial to keep a daily journal of my thoughts.
Attending art galleries inspires my creativity and appreciation for culture.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any challenges in maintaining your exercise routine?
Q3: How important do you think regular exercise is for overall health?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone just starting to exercise?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about food preferences.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite type of cuisine and why?
Q2: Have you ever tried a food that you didn’t like at first?
Q3: How do you think cultural background influences food choices?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone looking to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What are some challenges you faced while traveling?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes travel enriching for individuals?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone planning their first trip abroad?
